integrity: Exact all-size proof by case splitting and Burnside; standalone exhaustive and exact-rational checks supplement rather than replace proof; no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the rooted star posets with at least two leaves and relations satisfying both named confluences are classified, modulo simultaneous leaf relabeling. No novelty is claimed for labelled two-level counts, general confluence conditions or modal semantics. An unindexed historical orbit enumeration remains possible; independent audit has not been done.
title: Cycle-index orbit census of doubly confluent modal frames on rooted stars
